description: bank 10 on the right foot turns about the pivot on the +X side, which is bankIn (4, 0, 10) here, since the right foot's pivots are mirrored: the same turn as the left foot's bank 10 about bankOut. The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target: (4, 4, 0) + 0.1 * (P - (0, 8, -6)).
